tools.name: generate_pdf
tools.description: Convert Markdown into a clean, professionally formatted PDF and return a downloadable URL. Supports # / ## / ### headings, **bold**, `code`, - bullet lists, 1. numbered lists, and --- rules. Free tier: 30/hour; pass Authorization: Bearer <key> for unlimited (buy a key at https://alpha-systems.net).

tools.name: markdown_to_html
tools.description: Convert Markdown into a styled, standalone HTML document. Returns a downloadable URL.

tools.name: markdown_to_docx
tools.description: Convert Markdown into an editable Microsoft Word (.docx) document. Returns a downloadable URL.

tools.name: merge_pdfs
tools.description: Merge multiple PDFs into a single PDF. Returns a downloadable URL.

tools.name: watermark_pdf
tools.description: Stamp a diagonal text watermark across every page of a PDF. Returns a downloadable URL.

tools.name: check_recalls
tools.description: Check whether a product, brand, drug, or vehicle has an official US recall or safety alert. Aggregates openFDA (food/drug/device), CPSC (consumer products), and NHTSA (vehicles, incl. VIN decode) into normalized JSON. Deterministic, official sources only — useful as a pre-purchase safety guardrail f

findings.detail: Description of "generate_pdf" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
